fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) has risen approximately 1,010% over five years, with fiscal year 2026 Q4 revenue surging 380% to $54.2B driven by surging AI infrastructure memory demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: The company holds 18% HBM and 21% DRAM market share, currently achieving 81% gross margin, with SK Hynix completing 50% pre-sales of production capacity for 2027–2028, suggesting sustained demand through 2030.
fields.summary_ko.2: While there is downside risk from memory cycle transitions, sustained supply shortage from 2027–2030 supports Micron's positive outlook.
